citation: Cheng Y., Cao L., Liu J., Wang Y., Zhou X. Intelligent analysis of dynamic characteristics of steel-concrete hybrid wind turbine tower based on adaptive vibration mode. Structures 68 (2024) 107235.
source_type: peer-reviewed article; personally inspected local PDF in this audit

actual_reading_scope.not_claimed: No claim of a new all-12-page scientific fulltext audit or of reproducing the paper computations.

locations.method: Represent nacelle and rotor by rigid points N and R with their own concentrated masses and rotational inertias; retain horizontal eccentricity and the height of point W relative to tower top.
locations.supports: Mass, reference position/eccentricity and inertia must be distinguished in RNA dynamics.
locations.limits: The theory studies the u/v bending directions; it is not a complete 3D six-DOF mass matrix derivation.

locations.method: RNA virtual work separates self-weight, translational inertia, rotational inertia and eccentricity-induced moment; W-point displacement includes tower-top displacement and slope terms; rotational work includes mass-times-eccentricity-squared terms.
locations.supports: Eccentric mass needs translational/rotational coupling and moments, beyond total-mass matching.
locations.limits: Do not copy signs/axes directly into the current Abaqus axes, or label the current M6 block formula as a Cheng equation.

locations.method: Place reference points at nacelle and rotor centers, apply concentrated masses/inertias at those two points, couple each to the tower-top section; Fig.5 explicitly labels rigid kinematic coupling.
locations.supports: Concentrated mass/inertia at offset reference points and rigid kinematic coupling to the supporting tower have a direct published precedent.
locations.limits: The main FE has two component reference points and a tower-top section; the paper does not disclose the MASS/ROTARYI keyword deck, coupling data lines, or the current single-CG-to-single-O topology.

locations.method: Apply prestress in static general, then perform frequency extraction about the resulting state using linear perturbation/Lanczos; compare first three frequencies and mode shapes in both lateral directions against the analytical method.
locations.supports: Separate preprocessing/base state from modal comparison and inspect more than one bending mode.
locations.limits: FE and analytical models both simplify RNA; this is not validation against flexible rotating aeroelastic RNA or operating loads. Current S1 has no tower or prestress and cannot perform this comparison.

locations.method: Compare PM, EPM, EPMJ and EDPMJ simplifications; EPMJ is a single eccentric mass with rotational inertia, EDPMJ has separate nacelle/rotor masses and inertias.
locations.supports: Current single-CG mass-plus-inertia representation is conceptually closest to EPMJ; mass-only agreement does not establish higher-mode fidelity.
locations.limits: The comparison does not demonstrate generic equivalence of every full 3D tensor, validate DTU10MW/R2 inputs, or prescribe a matrix/energy/gravity verification fixture.

what_is_not_in_the_paper: Explicit MASS or ROTARYI keyword identification/data lines
A published full 6x6 mass matrix or its solver export
A complete three-axis inertia tensor with three products of inertia
The current R2 mass, CG, JG or tower-top coordinates
A flexible rotating blade/aeroelastic validation establishing D08 closure
current_S1_decision: Published precedent supports preserving RNA mass, eccentricity, inertia and using rigid reference-point coupling. Single-CG/full-tensor implementation and isolated operator checks must be attributed separately to verified Abaqus definitions, rigid-body mechanics/project derivation, frozen R2 inputs, and the preregistered numerical verification design. Cheng alone does not validate the exact S1 implementation or physical applicability.
publication_control: Public form contains paraphrases and locators only, no original PDF, page image, extracted text, local personal paths or manuscript/advisor text. No upload or simulation performed by this reviewer.
T026_provenance_note: T026 M11 explicitly attributes the complete M6 operator and its verification to project derivation plus official definitions; M12 cites Cheng only for the prestress/base-state/modal procedure. Historical numerical equivalence is not current S1 validation or D08 closure.
